cur-fossil-ust-ishim.dateNote: In 2008 the ivory carver Nikolai Peristov found a human thigh bone on the bank of the Irtysh River in Siberia. Its DNA, read in 2014, was the oldest modern human genome then known. The bone is about 0.045 million years old. Pinned on the village of Ust'-Ishim (Q4478405).
cur-fossil-ust-ishim.summary: A thigh bone from Siberia with the oldest modern human genome known in 2014.
